purpose: Approved qualification definitions; this manifest is not an activation or a passing reading.

approval.approver: Project maintainer (the user in the approving conversation)
approval.authorization: 10 attended physical cuts; qualification/test-only code and root src/config.rs application settings excluded from coverage percentages; storage format v2 durable operation handoff and recovery metadata
approval.definition_hash_boundary: UTF-8 bytes preceding the ## Approval record heading, including the immediately preceding blank line
approval.effect: Satisfies the exact-byte definition/storage approval prerequisite. Physical measurements, attended cuts, exhaustive software cut points, measured production coverage thresholds and every other qualification requirement remain.

sensor_catalog.notes: Suggestions were keyword-based, not endorsements. SO-002b and SO-002c were reconsulted for verification-contract refinement; SO-002c and SO-005d for U1/U2/I1. Fixture failure is not a behavioral reading; mocks do not establish native interoperability; retries must not conceal timing failures.

SO-002b.name: Example-Based Tests
SO-002b.use: Lifecycle boundaries, CLI results, rejected certificates, restore publication
SO-002b.limitation: Same-author examples miss omitted behavior; fixture failure is no reading.

SO-002c.name: Integration Tests
SO-002c.use: Actual daemon, USB device, Haskell client, systemd and independent node
SO-002c.limitation: Mocks do not establish boundary compatibility.

SO-005e.name: Property-Based Testing
SO-005e.use: Generated evolution, discard/activation, retries, slot reuse and crash sequences
SO-005e.limitation: Only stated invariants; report rejected inputs and shrinking.

SO-003.name: Mutation Testing
SO-003.use: Weakened period, identity, cleanup and restore checks
SO-003.limitation: Operator coverage is incomplete; investigate survivors, not score averaging.

SO-003c.name: Line Coverage
SO-003c.use: Unexecuted shared-core and host error paths
SO-003c.limitation: Execution does not prove assertions or firmware coverage.

SO-005.name: Fuzzing
SO-005.use: USB, node-service, management, certificate and artifact decoders
SO-005.limitation: Crash oracle alone misses wrong but valid-looking results.

SO-016.name: Model Checking
SO-016.use: Finite Rust lifecycle model including torn commits, retries and activation/discard ordering
SO-016.limitation: Proof is bounded to the model, not implementation or physical flash.

SO-005c.name: Differential Testing
SO-005c.use: Sum6KES and file encoding against independent Haskell implementation
SO-005c.limitation: Agreement can share a bug; resolve disagreement against the governing format.

SO-005d.name: Fault Injection
SO-005d.use: Transaction cut points, lost replies, reconnect, actual power removal
SO-005d.limitation: Only injected faults covered; simulated storage is not physical qualification.

SO-006e.name: Load Testing
SO-006e.limitation: Synthetic timing alone misses correctness; independently verify each returned key.

sensor_catalog.gap_responses: Explicit release invariants, native compatibility runs, boundary review and operator exercise address risks without claiming catalog completeness. History-based prediction has no meaningful local implementation history. Production shadow/A-B/chaos against real pool keys is inappropriate; use isolated disposable networks.
sensor_catalog.not_selected: SO-014 Static Security Analysis was inspected but no Rust taint-analysis tool was demonstrated; do not label Clippy/audit SAST. Independent trust-boundary/security review remains required. P0 is a project gate, not an invented sensor ID.

tool_and_target_selection.production: Rust/Cargo 1.99.1, edition 2024; rustfmt, Clippy and LLVM tools from same toolchain; host x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; firmware thumbv8m.main-none-eabihf, RP2350 Cortex-M33.
tool_and_target_selection.native: Native node/client and independent oracle pins are in specs/001-pico2-kes-agent/research.md; record actual GHC/Cabal versions and resolved native dependency plan with each integration reading.
tool_and_target_selection.hardware: Record actual picotool, power-controller, probe, board silicon, fitted flash JEDEC/SFDP identity, firmware digest and stock clock; do not inherit an A4-only criterion.

global_rules.command_status: Commands name planned targets, not evidence of existing executables. Implement targets and nonempty oracles before accepting scope. The Cargo-host qualification package invokes real tools/devices and returns non-success on missing prerequisites.
global_rules.validity: Missing, stale, empty, failed or inconclusive required readings block acceptance. Foundation-only evidence does not pass G2. Unimplemented scenarios are pending, never passed; every increment applies selected gates to implemented scope. Missing tooling, hardware, leadership or approval is a blocker, not an invented exclusion.
global_rules.activation: Before trusting a gate implement checks and nonempty workloads and demonstrate appropriate seeded-defect or regression sensitivity. Approval and manifest creation do not activate gates or establish passing readings.
sensitivity: bypassed artifact signature or output collision
changed timestamp for same publication after reconnect
loss of terminal deletion timestamp before receipt handoff
acceptance below live incarnation period floor
global_rules.additional_sensitivity: Endurance evaluator rejects a single over-budget sector even if average wear passes, accepts exact equality at the 2× bound and marks missing rating/history/network inputs inconclusive. Model checking finds corresponding deliberately invalid transition; coverage exposes unexecuted error path. Demonstrate controlled-regression sensitivity for both P0 target scopes.
global_rules.campaign_integrity: Remove seeded defects before candidate measurement. Pin corpus/operator/model scope before evaluation; do not shrink after failure. Insufficient execution budget is inconclusive, not permission to omit paths.
global_rules.secrecy: Reports must not contain secret-bearing traffic, plaintext KES state or backup credentials. Destructive campaigns require disposable credentials and an explicitly selected isolated fixture. Replace retained disposable secret reproducer with a public/synthetic reproducible case before publication.
global_rules.occupancy: Use full occupancy where operation permits: generation starts with 64 active/63 staged and one vacant target staged slot; evolution with 64/64; activation/discard/deletion record intentional occupancy changes. Recover before restoring occupancy through supported commands; never reset replay history to simplify campaigns.
global_rules.release: Hardware-dependent acceptance requires actual A2 readings. Complete product acceptance requires every G1–G10/P0/P1 scope and SC-001–SC-009 to pass for the same candidate.

G1.name: build/dependencies
G1.scope_and_oracle: Check all host default members and firmware configurations, including separate host/no_std checks of maintained KES adaptation; no errors/warnings, unreviewed dependency advisories or license incompatibilities.

G2.name: behavior/integration
G2.scope_and_oracle: Named acceptance transitions and failures, foundation, actual native receiver/finalizer regressions and real CLI/daemon/socket/device smoke; no ignored required cases. Assert consumer-visible results, not forwarding, copied values or text. Foundation alone does not pass full G2.

scope: Real bounded USB/management decoders reject malformed, truncated and over-limit frames with documented rejection classes and allocation bounds

Unprivileged child without memory-lock bypass and RLIMIT_MEMLOCK=0 calls real protected-memory initializer on nonempty disposable data; observe OS denial, fail-closed initialization, no ready state or secret output; unavailable if denial cannot be enforced
Actual fixture parser rejects generated invalid public documents before USB, external tools or node contact
foundation.prerequisites: Implemented T010/T011 codecs, T013 host protection and T014 fixture parser; no daemon/CLI executable, hardware, external fixture, node or production credentials.
foundation.evidence: evidence/<candidate>/foundation/report.json: input class, expected/observed outcome, count and environment using common schema; public result on stdout/report, diagnostics stderr.
foundation.verdict: Exit 0 only when every named check executes and satisfies its oracle; missing execution, unavailable prerequisites, unexpected behavior or timeout return nonzero failed/inconclusive. Does not activate story, native or hardware scopes.

G2.c1_native_regression: See reload_qualification; real native receiver/finalizer cases registered in native runners and qualification/native/Main.hs and invoked via native-regression; record source/build/test command and case outcomes. Isolated historical exception-loop probe is insufficient.
G2.u1_u2_i1: Actual CLI/daemon/USB/pin-installation path exercises focused commissioning, publication and floor scenarios in specs/001-pico2-kes-agent/quickstart.md#focused-u1u2i1-validation.

G3.name: properties/model
G3.scope_and_oracle: At least 10,000 sequences of 1–256 actions over 64 pools; zero identity, monotonicity, cleanup or retention violations. Exhaustively explore all reachable states of finite model with 2 pools, active+staged, 3 periods, retries, torn write/erase and all race orderings, not random sampling; compare implementation transitions with model traces. Model identity commitment, publication atomicity and independent same-network pool floors.

G4.name: mutation
G4.scope_and_oracle: Zero unexplained non-equivalent survivors in identity, period, retry, cleanup, artifact authentication or output publication; at least 90% detection per remaining measured module. Report invalid mutants separately and classify timeouts instead of assuming broken harness detection.

G5.name: coverage
G5.scope_and_oracle: At least 90% line coverage per production host/shared crate; no changed-line coverage regression from approved baseline; behavioral scenarios exercise every changed security/lifecycle decision; root src/config.rs application settings, qualification, tests, benches, fuzz targets, test support and other qualification-only code are excluded from coverage results or have no percentage threshold; review annotated uncovered production lines. Hardware-only paths are covered by G8, not called host-covered.

G6.name: fuzz
commands: Repeat for node_service, management, certificate, artifact
G6.scope_and_oracle: Nonempty corpora reaching actual parsing/state validation; no crash, sanitizer violation, unbounded allocation or semantic invariant failure; record executions and coverage growth.

G7.name: differential
G7.scope_and_oracle: Every primitive period 0–63 including 31→32, first invalid period and network lifetime below 64; verification keys, signatures and serialized state agree with independent Haskell oracle. Restored key0 bytes equal disposable device generation-time reference and independent conventional decoder extracts identical bytes. Tampering, wrong recipient or wrong identity publish no usable file.

G8.name: faults
G8.scope_and_oracle: Exhaustive software persistent-transition boundaries plus 10 attended physical cuts across generation, certification, evolution, activation, discard, deletion and cleanup; zero acknowledged/released rollback; erase/read verification of every obsolete secret region; corrupt/ambiguous pool fails closed. Cut first-identity and publication transactions plus reply/confirmation/deletion handoff boundaries; record the operator-confirmed cut point and verdict per invariant. Unattended power automation is not required.

G9.name: primary node
G9.scope_and_oracle: Actual patched bulk node with 64 agent pools, separate mixed legacy/versioned file-agent and singleton cases. Preserve supported baseline sources and malformed/missing-file semantics without restoring removed forge changes. Independently accepted blocks before/after evolution, SIGHUP, rotation and full power recovery; healthy pools continue through isolated agent outage and that agent recovers on return. Missing leadership opportunities are inconclusive; no backup producer required. Complete reload_qualification; signal delivery or protocol-only test is insufficient.

G10.name: operator/security
G10.scope_and_oracle: Operator completes quickstart through installed utility, common socket policy, no extra credentials or direct CLI USB. Distinguish denied/unavailable/rejected/uncertain outcomes. No secret logs/dumps/files on primary. Exercise offline restore, all warnings and focused U1/U2/I1 actual CLI/daemon/USB/pin-installation scenarios.

P0.name: microbenchmark
P0.scope_and_oracle: Execute both targets for approved first correct baseline and candidate in isolated build locations with identical pinned toolchain, dependency/build flags, CPU/governor, filesystem/mount/device and cache preparation. Record fixed input sizes, periods, journal occupancy and cleanup before measurement; do not change between revisions or after failure. Three separately retained runs per revision and target with unique RUN_LABEL values; 100 samples, 5-second warmup and 10-second measurement per case. For every workload, 95% runtime-ratio CI wholly <=1.05 passes, wholly >1.05 fails, crossing is inconclusive. Missing/stale/failing/inconclusive target or workload, or combined budget overrun, produces nonzero. Do not average away regressions. Baseline approval is not a candidate pass.

targets.name: kes-core/lifecycle
targets.scope: Generation, one-period evolution, valid multi-period catch-up including 31→32, certificate and artifact verification with disposable independently checked inputs

targets.name: pico2-kes-agent/host
targets.scope: Actual protocol framing at ordinary and maximum valid message sizes; public intent/result journal append with real fsync and restart reconciliation at declared small/near-admission-limit sizes

P1.name: physical capacity
P1.scope_and_oracle: 64 active plus 64 staged fit simultaneously; every one of 64 concurrent current-key requests finishes within 10 seconds; all valid pools recover within 60 seconds after all stated prerequisites are available. Verify pool/certificate/signing correctness for every result; exercise slow/malformed clients, reconnect, full-boundary evolution and background generation. No percentile hides a missed pool. Include additional context-floor, commissioning and deletion writes and unchanged maximum-size/endurance constraints.

endurance.workload: five years with monthly extra churn
endurance.per_sector_rule: 2 * (prior wear + projected service erases) <= guaranteed rating
endurance.limitation: Lifetime projection is not a five-year soak test.

reload_qualification.status: Approved current requirement; unmeasured, not a future synchronization task.
reload_qualification.native_cancellation: G2 exercises actual blocked service I/O and reconnect delay; each awaited cancellation and resource/key finalization completes within 5 seconds, with zero reconnect attempts after cancellation. Record native failing-before/passing-after outcomes. Both dedicated AsyncCancelled and broad SomeException handlers propagate asynchronous termination; genuine service failures retain reconnect behavior.
reload_qualification.repeated_reload: For each valid topology complete ten sequential observed-complete post-initialization reloads, including unchanged and updated valid contents. Alternate blocked-I/O and reconnect-delay cases for agent receivers where applicable; coalesced signals do not count as completed reloads.
reload_qualification.healthy_replacement: With valid period context and healthy sources available, all healthy replacement workers usable within 60 seconds of post-initialization SIGHUP; awaited receiver cancellations within 5 seconds. Record unchanged node PID, old receiver/socket retirement, zero receiver accumulation, file-key catch-up without rewriting files, and fresh correctly bound agent bundles.
reload_qualification.isolated_outage: During explicit reload unavailable agent replacement may remain keyless without blocking healthy workers or file fallback; on return obtain usable fresh bundle within 60 seconds of transport and valid context availability; verify accepted blocks at declared leadership opportunities. Ordinary disconnect without reload preserves existing worker's valid key.
reload_qualification.boundary_failures: Exercise early-init not-effective behavior only after SIGHUP handler installation, never signal an unprepared process. Preserve T004 exact malformed/missing-file outcomes, reject unsupported sources, and prove future/expired file keys cannot sign outside validity. These are not successful reloads.
reload_qualification.fixture_and_oracle: Predeclare topology, reload sequence, source state, expected healthy pools, observation points and leadership windows within G9's unchanged 8-hour budget. Expected valid pools need observed leadership opportunities before and after named transitions; missing opportunities/evidence are inconclusive. Independently verify accepted blocks. Hung cancellation, leaked receivers, changed key files, wrong-pool delivery or missed readiness bounds fail. No raw keys or secret-bearing traffic in evidence.
reload_qualification.unchanged_targets: Existing 10-second steady delivery and 60-second recovery gates remain; reload bounds neither promise zero-gap replacement nor make SIGHUP necessary for automatic rotation.

dispatch.report_policy: Required-scope validation rejects missing, oversized, symlinked, invalid, stale-candidate, stale-definition, empty, unexecuted, failed and inconclusive reports. Dispatch-only success is never a G1/G2/firmware/native/product acceptance reading.
